verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents automating the tailnet through infrastructure-as-code providers and integrations (tailscale-docs-12). Community reports mention API keys (tailscale-comm-17) and ACLs being updated programmatically by a Slack bot (tailscale-comm-4), which indicates a management API exists. Nothing shows the API matches the admin console feature for feature, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths (tailscale-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, coverage of the API across features such as users, policy, and devices, and independent corroboration of full programmatic control.
